Apex Space | Multiple Roles | Full-Time | Onsite | Los Angeles, CA | apexspace.com

Apex Space is building standardized spacecraft platforms to enable true mass-production of spacecraft and enabling getting varied and similarly mass-produced payloads to orbit.

We're hiring everything from technicians to product/project managers to all sorts of engineers: thermal, mechanical, mechanisms, optical, power systems, electronics/avionics, PCB, embedded software, ground software, full stack, devops, and more.

You can apply at https://www.apexspace.com/careers. Or, email me with a resume at maabonnet [at] gmail [dot] com, and I'll get you a direct referral link so that you get a call with a recruiter ASAP.

NOTE: Due to federal law, you must be a US person (citizen, green card holder, some other classifications) to work at Apex Space. Please state your residency or citizenship status in your email.
